adaptation.name: Wedge & Rise
adaptation.preserved: Default socket4.50x1.70mm and1.60mm sheet. Card carrier and low-runner concept reconstructed with real CSG union.
adaptation.proposed: Tongue4.40x1.60mm; .10mm TOTAL socket gap default (.10–.25 adjustable), .20–.40mm PER-SIDE guide clearance; stronger .4–.6mm tall,.8–1.2mm wide tabs. These are design choices, not source measurements or universal fits.
adaptation.newGeometry: Five-part inclined-wedge mechanism: deck, two upright window guides, upright wedge and horizontal lifting crossbar. Angle12–22degrees, length44–54mm and half-stroke6–9mm. Lift2*stroke*tan(angle); uphill lower crossbar edge is contact. Four source-size sockets receive fixed guide feet. All five parts held by20 real runners in one connected frame.
adaptation.retention: Fixed feet require glue. Crossbar and wedge remain loose/removable, user-guided, level only. No load rating, physical stops or self-locking claim.
adaptation.differentFromPrior: Not a seated-disc illusion, inclined-plane sled, or pivot mechanism: positive inclined-edge contact drives a window-constrained vertical crossbar. No source spacecraft outlines copied.
adaptation.sourceDefectHandling: No raw mesh import, repair, automatic hull or source topology reuse. Original analytic Manifold CSG reconstruction uses measured dimensions only.
adaptation.accessibility: 8mm-tall low-end grip remains at least8mm beyond guide ends across full stroke; enlarged deck supports grip tip with3mm edge margin. Actual travel ticks align with grip leftmost tip. Lower card divider shifted12%width to house the long grip without overlaps.
